summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, reporting daily ASX disclosures (Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2) required under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program for Class A and Class B common stock. No new authorization, price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed; the program operates at management's discretion under applicable securities laws. The filing is routine disclosure, not a special-situation event. For risk-arb, the relevant angle is ongoing buyback cadence and its support for the share price rather than any deal terms or structural change.
